mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.intro: MCP servers give agents extra tools. Each one is a program on this Mac or a web service that you choose and start on purpose. The IDE only decides whether an agent may call a tool; it cannot see what the server does with it.
mcp.empty.title: No MCP servers yet
mcp.empty.text: Add a server by hand, or import the ones you already use in Claude Code. Nothing starts until you confirm it.
mcp.error.load: MCP settings could not be loaded.
mcp.banner.newer: These MCP settings were written by a newer version of the IDE and cannot be edited here.
mcp.banner.readOnly: Read-only mode: MCP servers cannot be tested or started.
mcp.problem.entry: A saved entry could not be read ({reason}).
mcp.row.changed: Changed since you confirmed it (its settings or a file it runs)
mcp.row.fetchesCode: Downloads its code at every start
mcp.remove.title: Remove {name}?
mcp.remove.body: The server and its stored secrets are deleted. A run that is already going can no longer call its tools.
mcp.workspace.label: In {workspace}
mcp.workspace.hint: Applies to new runs. A run that is already going keeps its servers; to stop one, set its tools to Deny or remove it.
mcp.field.name: Name
mcp.field.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It is the prefix of the tool names agents see.
mcp.field.commandHint: A program name or full path. It is started directly, not through a shell.
mcp.field.argsHint: One per line. Do not put keys or tokens here; use an environment variable marked secret.
mcp.field.urlHint: https, or http to this Mac only.
mcp.field.headersHint: Prefer a header for a secret: a variable can be read by other programs running as you.
mcp.field.enabledHint: New runs start with this server selected. You can change it per workspace and per run.
mcp.var.name: Name
mcp.var.secretLocked: Names like this are always stored as secrets.
mcp.err.mcpBadName: Use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
mcp.err.mcpNameTaken: Another server already has this name.
mcp.err.mcpSecretInArgs: An argument looks like a key or token. Move it into an environment variable marked secret.
mcp.err.mcpBadUrl: Use an https address (letters, digits and xn-- only), or http to localhost.
mcp.err.mcpSecretInUrl: The address contains a credential. Put it in a header marked secret.
mcp.err.mcpExecVar: This variable changes how programs start or where they download from, so it cannot be set here. Put it in a script of your own.
mcp.err.mcpPlainSecretName: This name or value looks like a secret, so it must be stored as a secret.
mcp.err.mcpRelativePath: Use a full path (starting with /) or a bare program name. A path inside the project (./ or ../) would run whatever is there.
mcp.err.mcpBadChars: This contains a control, invisible or text-direction character. Remove it.
mcp.err.mcpCodeTooBig: This file is too large to check (over 1 GiB).
mcp.err.mcpBlockedByDefault: This tool is blocked by default. Confirm that you want to allow it.
mcp.err.reservedNamespace: This setting is managed by the MCP section only.
mcp.confirm.title: Run this program?
mcp.confirm.body: {name} is code you chose to run. It runs as you, outside the IDE's safety checks, whenever a run or a test uses it. The IDE can stop an agent from calling its tools, but it cannot see what the server does with them: a server that talks to GitHub can commit and push, even though agents themselves cannot.
mcp.confirm.hiddenValues: Some values came from the imported file and are hidden. Confirm only a file you trust.
mcp.confirm.idn: This host uses an international name in its encoded form (xn--). Check that it is the address you expect.
mcp.confirm.files: Files this server runs (confirming covers their current content)
mcp.confirm.unpinned: This starts a package that is downloaded from a registry every time it runs, so what you confirm here is not the code that will run. Pin a version (name@1.2.3) or install it once and use the full path.
mcp.test.ok: Connected in {seconds} s: {server}, {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}.
mcp.test.noAnnotations: This server does not say which tools only read, so none is treated as read-only.
mcp.test.truncated: Only the first {count} tools were read.
mcp.test.blocked: Blocked by default: {names}. The IDE's agents never commit, push or deploy. Change a rule in the table if you really want it.
mcp.test.instructions: This server also gives the model these instructions
mcp.test.instructionsChanged: These instructions changed since the last test.
mcp.test.code.mcpSpawnFailed: The program could not be started. Check the command and that it is installed.
mcp.test.code.mcpTimeout: No answer in time. A first start may download a package; try again with more time.
mcp.test.code.mcpProtocol: The server did not speak MCP. A stdio server must print only protocol messages on standard output.
mcp.test.code.mcpAuth: The server wants credentials the IDE does not have. Check the header secrets.
mcp.test.code.mcpAuthOauth: This server needs a login the IDE cannot perform yet (OAuth).
mcp.test.code.readOnly: Read-only mode does not start MCP servers.
mcp.test.code.testJail: The test jail only allows servers on this Mac.
mcp.test.code.mcpSecretMissing: A secret has no value yet. Edit the server and enter it.
mcp.tools.title: Tools and rules
mcp.tools.default: For tools without their own rule
mcp.tools.stale: The command or address changed since the last test, so read-only marks are ignored. Test again.
mcp.tools.never: Run a test to list this server's tools.
mcp.tools.staleRules: Rules for tools the last test did not list: {names}
mcp.tools.modesTitle: How each mode treats these rules
mcp.tools.modePlan: Plan: only tools set to Allow that the server marks read-only.
mcp.tools.modeAsk: Ask and Accept edits: Allow runs, Deny is blocked, Ask asks (read-only tools run without asking).
mcp.tools.modeAuto: Automatic and Bypass: nothing asks. Only Deny blocks a tool.
mcp.tools.modeAutoUnlisted: Automatic also blocks tools the last test did not list, unless the server default is Allow.
mcp.tools.liveHint: Blocking applies to running runs at once. Allowing again applies from the next start.
mcp.tools.blocked: Blocked by default: the IDE's agents never commit, push or deploy
mcp.tools.unblock.title: Allow {tool}?
mcp.tools.unblock.body: This tool looks like it commits, pushes or deploys. An enabled server does that with your credentials, and in Automatic and Bypass nothing asks first.
mcp.import.title: Import from Claude Code
mcp.import.intro: Choose a Claude Code settings file, such as ~/.claude.json or a project's .mcp.json. Only its list of MCP servers is read. Secrets go straight into the Keychain and are never shown.
mcp.import.projectNote: Servers saved for a single project inside ~/.claude.json are not included; choose that project's .mcp.json for those.
mcp.import.none: No servers found in this file.
mcp.import.secretNote: Secrets are imported straight into the Keychain and are never shown.
mcp.import.issue.secretInArgs: A secret is in the arguments: add this server by hand
mcp.import.issue.secretInUrl: A secret is in the address: add this server by hand
mcp.import.issue.unresolvedRef: Needs a value: it referred to an environment variable
mcp.import.issue.badVar: A variable is not on the safe list: add this server by hand
mcp.import.issue.badChars: Contains an invisible or control character: add this server by hand
mcp.import.issue.relativePath: Runs a file inside the project (./ or ../): install it elsewhere and add this server by hand
mcp.import.done: {count, plural, one {Imported # server} other {Imported # servers}}. Confirm each one to use it.
mcp.import.expired: The preview expired. Choose the file again.
mcp.import.invalid: This file could not be read as Claude Code settings.

mcp.picker.warnBypass: Bypass runs call these servers' tools without asking. Only tools set to Deny stay blocked.
mcp.picker.warnSecretEnv: {names} keep a secret in their environment. In this mode an agent can run programs that read other programs' environments; prefer a header-based server or leave those tools on Deny.
mcp.picker.warnExposure: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} of {names} change things and would run without asking.
mcp.exposure.line: In this mode, {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} of {names} that change things run without asking.
mcp.exposure.secretEnv: {names} keep a secret in their environment; in this mode a script an agent runs can read it.
mcp.picker.hintPlan: Plan only offers tools you set to Allow that the server marks read-only.

mcp.runerr.mcpSecretMissing: An MCP server is missing a secret. Edit it in Settings.
mcp.runerr.mcpAuthModeUnsupported: MCP servers cannot be used with an API key login.
mcp.runerr.mcpUnavailable: MCP is not available in this build.
mcp.runerr.mcpCodeInRunDir: A server's program lies inside the project folder, where an agent could change it. Install it elsewhere and use the full path.
mcp.runerr.mcpCodeTooBig: A server's program file is too large to check.
